title: Listen and Choose a Response — Book Club

questions.stem: Have you finished the book for Thursday's meeting?

options.A: I've got two chapters left, but I'll finish tonight.
options.B: Thursday's meeting is at the library.
options.C: Yes, I'll start reading it next month.
options.D: The book was written by a local author.

questions.explanation: Explaining how much is left answers the question indirectly; the 'Yes' option contradicts itself.
